questions.question: What is a primary benefit of using Google’s custom-designed TPUs?

options.text: TPUs increase the storage capacity and data retrieval speeds within Google Cloud data centers.
TPUs are lightweight processors intended for deployment on edge devices.
TPUs are specialized AI processors that excel at parallel processing for machine learning workloads.
TPUs are primarily designed to improve the general processing speed of virtual machines in the cloud.

questions.explanation:
Google TPUs are specialized AI accelerators designed for machine-learning workloads. Their matrix-processing architecture performs the large, parallel computations used in model training and inference efficiently.\
\
**Learn more:** [Introduction to Cloud TPU](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/intro-to-tpu)

questions.question: A marketing team wants to use a foundation model to develop social-media and advertising campaigns. They want to generate written articles and images from text. The team lacks deep AI expertise and needs a versatile solution. Which Google foundation model should they use?

options.text: Gemini
Gemma
Veo
Imagen

questions.explanation:
Gemini is a versatile multimodal model family that can generate written content and can generate images from text prompts. This makes it suitable for producing both campaign articles and visual assets in one general-purpose solution; Veo is focused on video, Imagen on images, and Gemma is an open-weight model family intended for developer extension.\
\
**Learn more:** [Gemini API in Vertex AI quickstart](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/start/quickstart) · [Use Gemma open models](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/open-models/use-gemma)

questions.question: A financial institution uses generative AI (gen AI) to approve or reject loan applications but provides no reasons for rejection. Customers are beginning to file complaints. The company needs to implement a solution to reduce these complaints. What should the company do?

options.text: Fine-tune the gen AI model.
Collect a larger and more diverse dataset for the gen AI model.
Implement explainable gen AI policies.
Develop fairness assessments for the gen AI model.

questions.explanation: Explainable generative AI policies require decision-making to be interpretable and provide understandable reasons for adverse outcomes such as loan rejections. This directly addresses customers’ inability to understand why their applications were denied.

questions.question: A financial institution uses generative AI (gen AI) to approve or reject loan applications but provides no reasons for rejection. Customers are beginning to file complaints. The company needs to implement a solution to reduce these complaints. What should the company do?

options.text: Fine-tune the model on a larger dataset of news articles.
Use grounding to base the model output on the source articles.
Implement stricter safety settings to filter out potentially controversial topics.
Increase the temperature setting of the model to encourage more diverse outputs.

questions.explanation:
Grounding provides the source articles as the factual basis for generation, so the summary is based on the supplied material rather than unsupported model-generated details. This reduces the risk of inaccurate or fabricated outputs.

**Learn more:** [Groundedness detection in Azure AI Content Safety](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-safety/concepts/groundedness)

A company wants to build an AI-powered educational solution that delivers personalized learning experiences for students. The platform will evaluate a student’s knowledge, recommend relevant learning materials, and create personalized exercises. The application would provide lesson structure and monitor progress. What type of AI solution should it use?

options.text: A learning management system (LMS)
A customized learning agent
An AI-powered recommendation system for learning resources
A large language model fine-tuned on educational content

questions.explanation: A customized learning agent is an AI system that orchestrates multiple coordinated actions—evaluating student knowledge, recommending tailored materials, generating personalized exercises, and adapting based on progress. This agentic approach better captures the dynamic, multi-step intelligence required compared to a static LMS framework. Modern generative AI solutions for education leverage agent patterns to deliver adaptive, personalized learning experiences.

questions.question: What is the definition of an AI agent?

options.text: An application that learns how to achieve a goal based on inputs and tools available to it.
A human expert who oversees and manages the operation of a gen AI application.
A type of user interface that allows users to interact with a gen AI application.
A static component of a gen AI application that provides information to the user.

questions.explanation: An AI agent is an application that pursues a goal by using the inputs and tools available to it, adapting its actions as needed to achieve that goal.

questions.question: An organization requires an AI tool to analyze and summarize long customer-feedback text transcripts. You need to select a Google foundation model with a large context window. Which foundation model should the organization select?

options.text: Gemini
CodeGemma
Imagen
Chirp

questions.explanation:
Gemini is a general-purpose foundation-model family for understanding and generating text, including summarization, and it supports large context windows suitable for processing lengthy customer-feedback transcripts. CodeGemma targets code, Imagen targets image generation, and Chirp targets speech recognition.\
\
**Learn more:** [Google models — Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/google-models)

questions.question: An organization needs to rapidly experiment with various Gemini models and parameters for content creation, without a complex setup. Which service should the organization use for this initial exploration?

options.text: Vertex AI Studio
Vertex AI Prediction
Google AI Studio
Gemini for Google Workspace

questions.explanation:
Google AI Studio provides a browser-based environment for quickly trying Gemini models and prompts. Its Run settings let users adjust model parameters, making it suitable for early content-generation experimentation without the Google Cloud project setup generally required for Vertex AI Studio.\
\
**Learn more:** [Google AI Studio quickstart](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/ai-studio-quickstart) · [Quickstart: Send text prompts to Gemini using Vertex AI Studio](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/start/quickstarts/quickstart)

questions.question: A company needs a generative AI platform that supplies the infrastructure, tools, and pre-trained models required to build, deploy, and manage its generative AI solutions. Which Google Cloud offering should the company use?

options.text: BigQuery
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
Google Cloud Storage
Vertex AI

questions.explanation:
